status_legend.implemented-on-candidate: The mapped source implementation is present on the candidate; this remains UNACCEPTED until the acceptance receipts are complete.
status_legend.partial: The surface exists, but a PR22 route, control, action, design value, host binding, or source/visual verification remains incomplete.
status_legend.unverifiable: Source exists but the contract is native/device-only and cannot be verified by the JVM suite on this Linux host.

entries.notes: The only shared frame in Android is still the old 402x874@3 (UiMetrics.BASELINE_WIDTH_PT/HEIGHT_PT); no 430x932 frame constant was found in the candidate. HomeSpec.swift is the PR22 authority but has no Android counterpart.

entries.notes: Runtime details is present as an Android page with tests; it uses legacy page chrome.
Catalog/empty/error states and create/update/delete host calls are wired through HostAutomation.
The editor form, validation, submit/discard and request-bound save receipt exist; host write calls are implemented in HostAutomation.save.
Detail/history paging exists; host history read is wired through HostAutomation.history.

The sheet exists, but the chat header only draws the 定时任务 row when schedules are non-empty and the host populates ChatSubpageFacts.schedules; empty/read-failure entries are not reachable from the header.

The sheet exists, but HostShell only fills ChatSubpageFacts.schedules and never fills .jobs, so the 后台任务 row never appears in the product even when jobs exist (null callback/list masquerading as "no row").
PR22 opens a subagent catalog from the chat header and lists/opens subagents. Android has no NativeSubagentCatalogSheet equivalent (no symbol found) and the header menu row is absent.
Command settlement/result page is implemented; the host command execution itself is limited to the chat command bridge.

The preview/share sources and intent/share chooser exist, but the native Android share sheet and SAF import cannot be exercised by the JVM suite; installed-App verification is NOT_RUN on this Linux host.
The workbench exists, but its only product entry is through chat subpage facts that the host fills only partially; the PR22 右侧边栏 → 工作面板 entry is not present.
The page and its injected-connector states exist; the product passes no connector and the route says so. It is honest about unavailable transport.
The read-only monitor exists with paging; real device transport is not present and is disclosed.

The shell wires routes, facts and actions, but the home is HostSessionsScreen and the drawer is PdshDrawer. Several host actions are honest refusals (export, shell exec, MCP save, web search writes); this is a partial host binding, not an accepted one.
The route host renders the settings/chat/secondary routes and passes callbacks; it is compiled and tested by the JVM suite.
The typed facts snapshot is the UI interface; it is constructed from real host/device reads in HostNavFacts.kt.
The pure projection owns transcript/composer/pending state and is exercised by ChatScreenStateTest and the JVM suite.
The projector folds Worker events into typed UI state and is tested by UiStateProjectorRulesTest.
The app-side adapter feeds ChatScreenState from real turns/snapshots; it is exercised by ChatSurfaceTest and ChatWiringTest.
The persisted session/transcript snapshot exists with restore tests (ChatSessionSnapshotTest).
The schedule catalog/create/update/delete/history host binding exists and is wired through ProbeEngineViewModel.handleAutomationAction.
A real provider connectivity test seam exists and is called from HostShell for TestProvider; get-models itself is still missing from the page.
The Activity owns edge-to-edge and the real launch/permission seams; platform-only behavior is instrumented-test territory.

The token pipeline is real (generated from spec/ui/v1/tokens.json and checked by ui_check), but the token values are the old 402pt DSH palette/type/geometry, not PR22 HomeSpec. This is the shared root of the per-page partial statuses.
The app-egress rules page exists with validation and tests; it documents that it is the App-level HTTP policy, not the DSH settings allow-list.
The editor exists, but the host has no phone/mcpUpsert tool so saving is refused, and the baseline page_structure ratchet still records the save label divergence as a known row.

The folder list/create/rename/delete page exists with validation and tests; the host refuses the folder writes (honest refusal), and the page is reachable from Android 开发者工具 rather than the PR22 settings row.
The Android editor exists with name/key/URL/model/effort fields and a save/test receipt, but lacks the PR22 获取模型 flow, 高级设置 (context/output/manual models), protocol hint and the exact field copy.
The preview subpage and share chooser exist; native QuickLook is replaced by the real Android share intent, which is the correct platform boundary but device-only to verify.

PR22 opens SessionQueuePage from the session row and can edit/steer/remove queued messages. Android SessionsPage.kt says L55 removed the page, and no Android queue page or navigation destination remains.
